## Subscribing to ISC Event Triggers via API

ISC's **Trigger Service** lets you register an HTTP endpoint to receive webhook calls whenever specific lifecycle events fire. The flow is two steps: discover the trigger you want, then create a subscription.

---

### Step 1 — Find the trigger ID

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/triggers
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

This returns all available triggers. For lifecycle events, look for IDs like:

| Trigger ID | Event |
|---|---|
| `idn:access-request-submitted` | New access request submitted |
| `idn:access-request-pre-approval` | Before approval decision (supports veto) |
| `idn:access-request-post-approval` | After approval decision |
| `idn:provisioning-action-completed` | Provisioning finished (success or failure) |
| `idn:identity-attributes-changed` | Identity attribute values changed |
| `idn:account-attributes-changed` | Managed account attributes changed |

---

### Step 2 — Create the subscription

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/trigger-subscriptions
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "triggerId": "idn:access-request-post-approval",
  "name": "My Service - Access Request Approved",
  "description": "Notify my service when access is approved",
  "type": "HTTP",
  "httpConfig": {
    "url": "https://my-service.example.com/isc/events",
    "httpAuthenticationType": "BEARER_TOKEN",
    "bearerTokenAuthConfig": {
      "bearerToken": "your-shared-secret-token"
    }
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "filter": "$[?($.requestedFor[0].type == 'IDENTITY')]"
}
```

**Key fields:**

- `triggerId` — the trigger you want to receive (from Step 1)
- `type` — `HTTP` for a webhook; `EVENTBRIDGE` for AWS EventBridge
- `httpConfig.url` — ISC will POST JSON payloads to this URL
- `httpAuthenticationType` — `NO_AUTH`, `BASIC_AUTH`, or `BEARER_TOKEN`
- `bearerTokenAuthConfig.bearerToken` — a shared secret ISC sends in the `Authorization` header on each delivery, so your service can verify the call is genuine
- `filter` — optional JSONPath expression to narrow which events trigger delivery (omit it to receive all)

---

### What ISC delivers

When the event fires, ISC sends a `POST` to your URL with a JSON body specific to that trigger type, e.g. for `idn:provisioning-action-completed`:

```json
{
  "trackingNumber": "4b4400fe-8867-4975-a....",
  "sources": "Corp AD",
  "action": "ADD_ACCESS",
  "errors": null,
  "warnings": null,
  "recipient": { "type": "IDENTITY", "id": "...", "name": "John Doe" },
  "requester": { "type": "IDENTITY", "id": "...", "name": "Jane Admin" },
  "accountRequests": [ ... ]
}
```

---

### Other subscription management endpoints

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/beta/trigger-subscriptions` | List all your subscriptions |
| `GET` | `/beta/trigger-subscriptions/{id}` | Get one subscription |
| `PATCH` | `/beta/trigger-subscriptions/{id}` | Update (enable/disable, change URL, etc.) |
| `DELETE` | `/beta/trigger-subscriptions/{id}` | Remove subscription |

---

### Auth

Use **OAuth2 client credentials** to get an access token:

```http
POST https://{tenant}.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={client_id}
&client_secret={client_secret}
```

The client needs the **`sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage`** scope (assign it in ISC under **Admin → API Management → OAuth Clients**).

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: GET
    path: /beta/triggers
    api_version: beta
  - method: POST
    path: /beta/trigger-subscriptions
    api_version: beta
  - method: GET
    path: /beta/trigger-subscriptions
    api_version: beta
  - method: PATCH
    path: /beta/trigger-subscriptions/{id}
    api_version: beta
  - method: DELETE
    path: /beta/trigger-subscriptions/{id}
    api_version: beta
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
auth_flow: OAuth2 client credentials bearer token
required_scopes: [sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage]
key_parameters: [triggerId, name, type, httpConfig, url, httpAuthenticationType, bearerTokenAuthConfig, enabled, filter]
```
